# The Zig toolchain, pinned by hash.
#
# ziglang on PyPI rather than a ziglang.org tarball: it is the Zig
# Software Foundation's own redistribution of the same builds, there is
# no zig package in Ubuntu's archives, and it puts the integrity check
# in pip rather than a hand-rolled sha256sum. Every published zig setup
# action targets a Node version GitHub now refuses.
#
# The same approach voxgig/struct takes; this file carries only the
# linux x86_64 wheel, because this repository's CI is ubuntu-only.
ziglang==0.16.0 \
    --hash=sha256:9fcda73f62b851dd72a54b710ad40a209896db14cfb13649e62191243556342b
